description:
Follow-up from ISS-011 / T-027. VAL-CAP-006b (declared frame-count tolerance under a working zero-copy DMA-BUF capture path; N-008 §6.1 round(duration × declared_fps) ± 1, unchanged) is adjudicated cannot-validate on the M1 NVIDIA / KDE Plasma 6 / Wayland host because DMA-BUF zero-copy hard-fails there and only SHM-fallback evidence exists (per N-008 §26.4 predicate complete). cannot-validate is not green and does not satisfy §24; the cell is parked here.

Goal: adjudicate VAL-CAP-006b to a real pass/fail on AMD (VAAPI, M2) or Intel (QSV, M3) hardware where DMA-BUF zero-copy succeeds. Verify DMA-BUF negotiation actually succeeds (capture.diagnostics.bufferType === "dmabuf", per VAL-CAP-009) before relying on the frame-count result. If, on a working zero-copy path, the declared-frame-count deficit persists beyond the §6.1 tolerance, that is a real capture/encoder defect (fail) — not cannot-validate.

Unblocks the §24 parking of VAL-CAP-006b. Requires AMD/Intel DMA-BUF validation hardware (M2/M3). Relates to ISS-011 and T-027. No threshold changes.

Execution spec (T-028 define-only pass, 2026-05-23): a verbatim-runnable spec for a future AMD/Intel DMA-BUF session is recorded at .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-23-t-028-execution-spec/ (assertion-definition, hardware-eligibility, dmabuf-success-criteria, evidence-bundle-template, decision-table, instrumentation-sufficiency, execution-prerequisites, iss-011-t010c-disposition), handover .story/handovers/2026-05-23-02-t-028-execution-spec.md, and note "T-028 execution spec". Define-only: no hardware validation run, no adjudication, no runtime/helper/validation change. Capture-side DMA-BUF instrumentation is sufficient, but encoder zero-copy import is NOT implemented (helper has NVENC+libx264 only; NVENC rejects DMA-BUF; VAAPI/QSV out of scope per T-017; dmabuf_imports emitted but never incremented in real code), so 006b is dual-gated: qualifying AMD/Intel hardware AND a VAAPI/QSV zero-copy encoder backend + real dmabuf_imports increment (implementation prerequisites — separate follow-up tickets, not created here). Adjudicator caveat: helper emits capture.diagnostics.buffers.buffer_type (not the bufferType prose in VAL-CAP-009) — use the emitted field. T-028 stays open; ISS-011 stays inprogress.
title: AMD/Intel VAL-CAP-006b zero-copy declared-frame-count validation (DMA-BUF)
